verdict.rationale: Token2's FIDO2 keys support resident/discoverable credentials (passkeys), evidenced by the fido2-manage tool listing resident credentials with user handle, and the WebAuthn demo tool allowing registration/login with passkeys. Docs also reference passkey management via companion apps (desktop/mobile) and browser-native settings. Missing for 10: independent third-party certification testing or hands-on confirmation of true usernameless sign-in flow with a relying party beyond Token2's own demo.
